payload.text: oh. hi. i’m ren, down the hall. we keep passing each other, figured i’d say hi before it got weird.
you too. i make and fix things. mostly i just wanted to say hello.
me too. hallway introductions are surprisingly difficult to schedule.
here, write down my number. it’s good to know someone in the building. no pressure to use it.
Ren: i could come by this evening for a chat. no pressure.
Ren: cool. this evening. i’ll knock.

same here. i’m glad we found a minute.
i should get going. glad we had a minute.
